android.desc:
🔐 THE PRIVATE OFFLINE ASTROLOGY APP WITH AI

Discover professional birth chart analysis without sacrificing your privacy. Locis combines advanced astronomical calculations with powerful on-device AI to deliver personalized astrology insights—completely offline. Your spiritual journey stays on your device, never in the cloud.

⭐ WHY CHOOSE LOCIS?

Popular astrology apps collect extensive personal data, require constant internet, and upload sensitive birth information to remote servers. Locis is different. No tracking. No cloud uploads. No data harvesting. Just pure astrological wisdom powered by local AI.

✅ 100% Offline — Works perfectly without internet
✅ On-Device AI Analysis — Zero cloud processing
✅ No Data Collection — Your charts stay private
✅ Professional Accuracy — High-precision ephemeris (1900-2100)
✅ Modern Beautiful UI — Glassmorphic design aesthetic

🎯 POWERFUL ASTROLOGY FEATURES

📊 NATAL BIRTH CHART CALCULATOR
Get your complete astrological blueprint with professional precision:
- Interactive zodiac wheel with all planetary positions
- Detailed house placements & cusps analysis
- Comprehensive aspect patterns & configurations
- Save unlimited birth charts for family & friends
- Vedic & Western astrology support
- High-precision astronomical calculations

🤖 PRIVATE AI PERSONALITY ANALYSIS
Experience deep astrological insights powered by local AI:
- On-device AI analyzes your natal chart privately
- Personalized character reports without privacy compromise
- Discover soul purpose, strengths & growth areas
- Career, relationships & life path guidance
- Daily horoscope tailored to your unique natal chart

❤️ SYNASTRY RELATIONSHIP COMPATIBILITY
Understand cosmic connections between two people:
- Compare birth charts for love, friendship & business
- Detailed compatibility scoring & analysis
- Composite chart creation & interpretation
- Kundli compatibility & Vedic astrology matching
- Discover your relationship's cosmic blueprint

📅 PROFESSIONAL EPHEMERIS & TRANSITS
Track celestial movements across centuries:
- Browse planetary positions from 1900 to 2100
- Real-time transit tracking & predictions
- Retrograde notifications & planning
- Astrological event calendar

☀️ DAILY PERSONALIZED HOROSCOPE
More than generic zodiac sign predictions:
- Daily horoscope based on YOUR unique natal chart
- Daily transit interpretations tailored to you
- Spiritual guidance aligned with current cosmic weather
